HOME.PULL_QUOTE: Ever since I was a child, I've looked at the natural world with wonder, convinced that every leaf hides a story and every burrow a small secret.
HOME.BIO_1: Today I use my watercolours to reveal that touch of magic we too often forget to look for.
HOME.BIO_2: I paint plants, flowers and animals, creating compositions alive with a delicate magic.
HOME.BIO_3: When I'm not holding a paintbrush, you'll probably find me wandering in nature looking for inspiration, or curled up on the sofa with a hot cup of tea and a book.
HOME.BIO_4: If you too need your daily dose of enchantment, you're in the right place.
HOME.PORTFOLIO_INTRO: A taste of my little watercolour world.
HOME.WORKSHOP_INTRO: Come paint with me: limited spots, guaranteed wonder.
